title: We liked it a lot...
text: We really liked discovering flamenco in this typical place; the artists lived up to our expectations. Very talented. Very good organization.
author: Marieange_S

title: Intimate experience with nerve and artistic brilliance.
text: An intimate experience that was completely magical. Outstanding presence, nerve, and artistic brilliance from everyone on stage – the guitarist, the singer, and the three flamenco dancers. An evening filled with passion, intensity, and pure magic.
author: ylvah2024

title: Excellent !
text: Superb experience in a cave, wonderful Flamenco dancing in a wonderful setting a very enjoyable evening.
author: Jennifer_G

title: Fun experience
text: A great experience for our family. Just the right length. Loved being so close to the performers.
author: kristinheery

title: Fabulous evening .
text: The evening was really exciting . It felt very authentic and I was impressed by how amazingly talented the dancers and musicians were .
author: Rose_H

title: Great experience, I want to go to class
text: Wow breathe taking! Stirring dance with pros. What an impressive performance. Three dancers, singer and Spanish guitar. Also zag and guitarist were great. Sitting in front, small space also makes it intimate
author: sanaeluun

title: A great, authentic way to experience flamenco!
text: This was a great experience! We loved watching the very skilled male and female flamenco dancers perform and to see flamenco dancing inside the gypsy caves was truly so special. Make sure you allow extra time for an uphill walk or catch a cab, and arrive on time or slightly early to get good seats! I would definitely recommend this!
author: Reem_A

title: This was a great show in...
text: This was a great show in a great venue. It was small, intimate setting. I really enjoyed the music and the dancers. I definitely recommend this. It was a great activity fir my first night in Granada.
author: Mark_E

title: A great experience with authentic flamenco up close
text:
A must go when you are in Granada. Just take the bus back and after the latest show by taxi (8 euros), or walk 20-30 min.
Experience flamenco in its most authentic form and up close.
author: Barbara_K

title: Traditional and typical Andalusian
text:
The show is very well recommended to discover a bit of the Flemish tradition. 
If you are driving 🚗 you should go with time to park as it is a bit complicated to drive through the streets of the area and the parking is a bit far. I recommend using public transport in the end is more comfortable than the car.
author: Jose_D
